title: Controlled 2015 cross-pair historical evidence acquisition
objective: Acquire and structurally compare EURUSD, GBPUSD and USDJPY for UTC year 2015 against the immutable AUDUSD/2015 RND-0031 reference without strategy evaluation or historical-calendar promotion.
success_criteria: Only EURUSD, GBPUSD and USDJPY UTC year 2015 are newly acquired
Every new shard passes the existing RND-0030 cryptographic/content verifier
AUDUSD/2015 remains an immutable reference and is not reacquired
Cross-pair comparison uses timestamp/gap structure only and emits no price or strategy outcome
The non-authoritative 17:00 New York hypothesis is tested independently for each pair
Shared versus pair-specific missing and unexpected timestamps are explicit
Returned candles cannot promote a calendar or holiday exception
No expansion beyond 2015 without a later human-reviewed task
stop_conditions: Any M005 signal, trade or performance calculation
Any credential or account identity committed
Any returned candle used as documentary calendar authority
Any broker-write, capital, strategy-selection, automatic promotion or automatic merge authority
